summary.zh-TW: 兩種常見的按鈕回饋：滑鼠靠近時按鈕被吸過去的磁吸效果，以及從點擊位置擴散的波紋。按下時按鈕會稍微縮小，給手指「壓下去」的感覺。
summary.en: Two common button feedbacks: a magnetic pull toward the cursor, and a ripple spreading from where you click. Pressing shrinks the button slightly so it feels pushed in.

text.zh-TW: 先建立好一個只改 x 的補間，之後每次滑鼠移動只丟新數值進去。比每次呼叫 gsap.to() 省效能，跟著滑鼠的動態都用它。
text.en: Creates a tween that only changes x, then feeds it new values on every mouse move. Cheaper than calling gsap.to() each time — use it for anything that follows the cursor.

text.zh-TW: 按鈕跟著滑鼠移動的比例。0.3～0.5 最自然；太大會像按鈕在逃跑。文字再多移一點（LABEL_EXTRA），做出前後層次。
text.en: How much the button follows the cursor. 0.3–0.5 feels natural; more and the button seems to run away. The label moves a bit further (LABEL_EXTRA) for depth.

text.zh-TW: 滑鼠離開時用有彈性的 ease 回到原位，像被橡皮筋拉回來。第二個數字越小，彈得越多下。
text.en: On leave it springs back with an elastic ease, like a rubber band. The smaller the second number, the more it wobbles.

text.zh-TW: 只在有滑鼠的裝置啟用磁吸。手機沒有「靠近」這件事，手指一碰就是點擊。
text.en: The magnetic effect only runs on devices with a mouse. Phones have no “approach” — a touch is already a tap.

text.zh-TW: 波紋要大到蓋住整個按鈕：用點擊位置到最遠角落的距離當半徑。本站全部直角，所以波紋用方塊擴散；加上 border-radius: 50% 就是傳統的圓形波紋。
text.en: The ripple must cover the whole button, so its radius is the distance from the click to the farthest corner. This site is square-cornered, so the ripple is a square; add border-radius: 50% for the classic round ripple.

text.zh-TW: 按下時縮小 4%，放開用 expo.out 彈回。縮太多（< 0.9）會顯得誇張。
text.en: Shrinks 4% on press and springs back with expo.out on release. Shrinking much more (< 0.9) feels exaggerated.
